exceptions.reason: The file reads the `current` of a React ref object. Vue `toValue` reads a ref, a getter or a value.

The file resolves the React `style` prop, which is an object or a function of the state. In Vase UI the `style` attribute and the `stateStyle` prop do this, and `useRenderElement` merges them. No Vase UI code needs the function.

exceptions.title: returns the runtime locale on the first client-only render
exceptions.reason: React tells a hydration from a client-only mount with the server snapshot of `useSyncExternalStore`. Vue has no public API that tells them apart in `setup`, so the first render of a client-only mount also gets en-US. The case "returns en-US for the first render of a client-only mount, then the runtime locale" states what Vase UI does.

exceptions.title: returns true before hydration for server-rendered markup
exceptions.reason: A server render runs in Node with no DOM. The case is in the test file that the Node project runs, with the same title.
